## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与修改后行为

Describe the trigger and the observable outcome. / 说明触发条件及可观察的结果。

## Verification / 验证

List relevant checks, platforms and any remaining limitations. State whether a real model request was made.
说明相关检查、平台与限制，以及是否调用真实模型。

## Review notes / 审查说明

Mention effects on credentials, project scope, accounting, task state, dependencies or isolation where relevant.
如有影响，说明凭证、项目范围、用量、任务状态、依赖或隔离的变化。

- [ ] Documentation is updated; both READMEs agree where relevant. / 文档已更新，涉及首页时已同步两种语言。
- [ ] Fixtures, screenshots and logs contain no private data. / 夹具、截图和日志无私有信息。
- [ ] Relevant checks passed, or failures/untested platforms are described. / 相关检查通过，或已说明失败与未验证平台。
